headline: Sensex Surges Over 1,500 Points as Nifty Reclaims 25,800 Amid Global Rebound and Strengthening Rupee

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian indices witnessed a massive rebound on November 25 with the Sensex jumping over 1,500 points.
Asian markets advanced as investors assessed fresh US tariff proposals and a late rebound in US stocks.
The Indian Rupee hit an eight-month high, providing a boost to domestic market sentiment.
The Indian government announced Rs 2,814 crore in support for lithium and nickel processing plants.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,800 level led by significant gains in heavyweights like Infosys, TCS, and HDFC Bank.
Oil prices hovered near $94 as Saudi oil attacks raised fresh supply fears in global markets.
S&P warned that Nvidia's board may be compromised, placing the chipmaker's rating on a downgrade watch.
SpaceX received FCC approval for 1 million satellites to develop data centres in space.
summary: Indian markets saw a sharp recovery with the Sensex gaining over 1,500 points, driven by a rally in IT and banking stocks. Global sentiment remains cautious but positive as Asian equities advance despite US tariff mayhem and rising Brent crude prices. Domestic tailwinds include a strengthening rupee and new government incentives for critical mineral processing.
